steps: Answer from the plan table: Basic 1,490 EGP/mo (2 staff, 300 orders/mo), Growth 3,490 (5 staff, 3,000 orders/mo, no Ebda footer, MCP), Business 9,990 (15 staff, unlimited orders, 3 stores, wholesale); platform fee 0 bps.
edgeCases: Prices are data in plans table, not hard-coded: assistant must read them live
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: No merchant-facing plan comparison API; /admin/plans is super-admin
